sources.title: Multimodal Speech Perception (MSP) - GitHub
sources.snippet: A multimodal speech perception models that converts and understands speech to text through audio and lip-reading signals. The MSP Model combines auditory and visual signals to improve speech recognition accuracy, especially in noisy environments or when audio signals are incomplete.

sources.title: Speech ReaLLM - Real-time Streaming Speech Recognition
sources.snippet: In a simplified experiment, we trained a non-streaming Time-aligned Speech LLM model that, like Speech LLM, gets the entire speech in its prompt, but like Speech ReaLLM, has BLANK symbols in the target strings.
